test__wrap_command: test the _wrap_command method that wraps a bash command with cd, eval, env export, and cwd marker scaffolding
test__extract_cwd_from_output: test the _extract_cwd_from_output method that extracts the working directory from command output using a session-specific marker
test__embed_stdin_heredoc: test the _embed_stdin_heredoc static method that embeds stdin data into a command via heredoc with a unique UUID delimiter
test_init_session_failure: test init_session failure handling that sets _snapshot_ready to False when _run_bash raises an exception
test_execute_login_flag: test the execute method that passes login=True to _run_bash when _snapshot_ready is False
